summary: Clarifies how Globally Routable User Agent URIs (GRUUs) should be used with the SIP event notification framework. Experience after RFC 6665 showed that the original text left room for different readings. This document spells out the intended behavior and updates RFC 6665.

eli5.summary: Two people kept reading the same rule differently, so someone wrote a short note saying what the rule really meant, like a teacher clarifying a confusing homework question.

questions: what is a gruu in sip
how do gruus work with sip event notifications
